data.name: Nursery Enfantasia

reviews.text: Horrible daycare. From the direction to the teachers. Cold and rude. Zero warmth. They yell at the children. Poor supervision as children are always getting hurt/bitten. Theres always an excuse to why they are hurt and it’s always when they aren’t paying attention to them and are distracted. They will not take any complaint seriously so we had to get the minister de la famille to investigate. They are liars and we had to take our child out of the daycare because of security issues. For the safety of my child. Comments from the teachers and the directors wife so unprofessional and they think they will intimidate me. No they really don’t. I know other parents who are they and some who left who have had issues with them. Moreover, they will not reimburse us for the days a service was not rendered and will not give us back the deposit we gave for the electronic keys. They are crooks. They are unprofessional and absolutely disgusting. Do not bring your child there. They yell at the children and “discipline” them by putting them in a corner and let them cry alone. If you care about your child’s mental health and wellbeing. Beware of this daycare.

We truly cannot express how grateful we are for this exceptional daycare. While we’re sad that our daughter will soon be moving on to school, we’re confident she is well prepared thanks to the outstanding care and education she received here. The management, teachers, and in-house chef are all fantastic—dedicated, attentive, and deeply involved. After hearing stories about other daycare experiences, we feel incredibly fortunate to have secured a spot in such a nurturing and high-quality environment. If you’re lucky enough to get a spot for your child, don’t pass it up!

I couldn’t be happier with the care my children receive at Garderie Enfantasia .From the moment we walked in, the staff made us feel welcome and reassured. They are incredibly nurturing, attentive, and genuinely invested in each child’s well-being and development. The daily routines are well-structured, with a great balance of educational activities, playtime, and rest. My child comes home excited to share what they’ve learned and always looks forward to going back. Communication is top-notch—daily updates, pictures, and quick responses to any questions or concerns. I have complete peace of mind knowing my child is in such capable and caring hands. Highly recommend this daycare to any parent looking for a warm, professional, and enriching environment for their child!
Parents should carefully evaluate alternatives before enrolling.

We have been part of this daycare for the past five years, and it truly feels like the end of an era for our family. Sending our children here has been one of the best decisions we’ve ever made.

The love, patience, and care they’ve shown our kids has meant more to us than words can say. Not only have our children been safe and happy every day, but they are also incredibly well prepared for school; academically, socially, and emotionally. You can see the foundation that was built here.

The staff go above and beyond. They treat the children like their own and create such a warm, supportive environment. As parents, that peace of mind is priceless.

We are so grateful for everything they’ve done for our family. Leaving is going to be very emotional for us because this place has truly been a second home.

Thank you
